query:
SELECT id, companyName, status,
  LEFT(coreCapabilities, 50) as cap_preview,
  LEFT(fitCriteria, 50) as fit_preview,
  LEFT(urgencyTriggers, 50) as urgency_preview
FROM offering_brain
WHERE status = 'completed'
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT 2;
